text:
maya: Quick PTAL — small batcher + metrics rename PR. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321

maya: Change: increase batcher timeout to 8ms (helps reduce tiny RPC bursts), and rename metric `batcher_wait_ms` -> `batcher_queue_ms` to better reflect semantics. Affects autoscaler signals so want a quick sanity check.

maya: Snippet:
```diff
diff --git a/batcher/config.go b/batcher/config.go
-    TimeoutMs: 5,
+    TimeoutMs: 8,
```

jon: Quick q — why 8ms? any perf numbers? :eyes:

maya: Ran a short prod-like trace replay — 99p tail for small requests dropped ~12% and overall token latency unchanged. Pasted the table in the PR description.

liam: Heads up: autoscaler dashboards query `sum(rate(batcher_wait_ms[5m]))` — will need updates or an alias.

elaine: Would prefer a short compatibility alias (emit both metrics for 7d) so oncall/dashboards don't break. Also a changelog note.

maya: Good call. I added a compatibility alias in the emitter and a RELEASE_NOTES entry in the PR, TTL planned for 7d.

jon: Any test flakes? unit/e2e status?

maya: CI green for unit + integration. e2e had one flaky unrelated test — filed as #437.

deploy-bot: CI passed — 14 checks successful.

liam: PTAL from infra side? specifically autoscaler hook behavior and metric naming.

elaine: I can review now. If no blockers, recommend merging after 2pm PST so I can update dashboards and pager docs.

jon: :eyes: i'll take a look in ~30m.

maya: Plan: canary on staging, then 10% prod for 1h. Rollback script: `scripts/rollback-batcher.sh <canary-id>`. Will monitor `batcher_queue_ms` and `inflight_small_requests`.

liam: Please add a short note in the infra runbook about the metric rename and autoscaler threshold mapping.

maya: Added runbook blurb in the PR and linked the infra mapping table.

elaine: LGTM, left two trivial comments on var naming (non-blocking).

jon: Review done, left a small nit about a log line. otherwise :shipit:.

maya: Thanks — merging after 2pm unless anyone objects.

liam: none from infra side, :thumbsup:.

deploy-bot: Merge scheduled by maya at 2025-02-10T21:00:00Z
